qgis_resources.subject: COLOURlovers palette noncommercial terms
qgis_resources.observed_text: Each notice names Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial-Share Alike 3.0 Unported and records qgis license=ccnc distribute=noncomm.
qgis_resources.question: Resolve whether to omit/replace these assets or obtain suitable permission for intended product distribution; do not treat core code licensing as approval for these resources.

qgis_resources.subject: Free-use labels with explicit no-distribution metadata
qgis_resources.observed_text: Both notices say Free to use and record qgis distribute=no license=freeuse. The td notice additionally says None specified; neo10 supplies no license-text element.
qgis_resources.question: Resolve an adequate redistribution grant or remove/replace the assets; the importer inclusion and free-use label do not settle distribution scope.

qgis_resources.subject: ElvenSword custom redistribution and preview conditions
qgis_resources.observed_text: The notice permits personal/commercial artwork use but separately conditions resource redistribution on credit, free sharing, original preview/name preservation and restrictions on merged collections. A source remark reports approval for inclusion in a 2009 journal entry; that external permission was not verified here.
qgis_resources.local_preview_observation: No PNG or JPEG preview files were found in the es subtree; the resource files are converted SVG palettes. This is not proof that all possible attribution/preview mechanisms are absent.
qgis_resources.question: Determine whether the retained asset/preview/credit form and intended distribution satisfy the actual permission, or select replacement assets.

qgis_resources.subject: Jim Mossman custom script-license wording on converted palettes
qgis_resources.observed_text: The notice labels Attribution required, while its full agreement describes a personal nontransferable license and derivative works supplied for a client's own internal use; it also requires the agreement with unmodified copies and author attribution.
qgis_resources.question: Resolve applicability and intended redistribution rights for the converted palettes from the full text rather than relying on the short label.

qgis_resources.subject: Default icon notice delivery
qgis_resources.observed_text: The notice states CC BY-SA 3.0 and requests including the license file. doc/CONTRIBUTORS names Robert Szczepanek.
qgis_resources.question: Establish the product attribution/license delivery mechanism for compiled default icons; the exact retained LICENSE.TXT is neither in images.qrc nor referenced by generated install rules. No conclusion about all other notice mechanisms is made.

qgis_resources.subject: ColorBrewer acknowledgement and naming conditions
qgis_resources.observed_text: The retained Apache-style Version1.1 text specifies a Cynthia Brewer acknowledgement in end-user documentation or normal in-product acknowledgements, notice preservation, and restrictions on endorsement/product naming.
qgis_resources.question: Map the required acknowledgement and naming terms into the product notice/brand review rather than treating Apache-style as a generic SPDX clearance.
